languageModelTools.name: shuncode_list_directory
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List one or two levels of a known workspace directory. Prefer this over recursive file search when you simply need to see what a directory contains.
languageModelTools.userDescription: List the contents of a workspace directory.

languageModelTools.name: shuncode_run_command
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a shell command in a ShunCode-managed VS Code integrated terminal. Idle ShunCode terminals with the same cwd are reused; concurrent or busy commands may use additional terminals. Commands require user confirmation when invoked from Chat.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run a command in a ShunCode-managed integrated terminal.

languageModelTools.name: shuncode_get_command_output
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read incremental output and status from a command previously started by ShunCode.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read output from a running or completed ShunCode command.

languageModelTools.name: shuncode_send_command_input
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Send input to a running ShunCode integrated terminal command.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Send text to a running ShunCode command.

languageModelTools.name: shuncode_get_diagnostics
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read current diagnostics from VS Code and active language services for the workspace or a scoped file/directory.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read current editor and language-service diagnostics.

languageModelTools.name: shuncode_lsp
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Navigate code semantically using the language services already active in VS Code. Use for workspace/document symbols, definitions, references, implementations, and hover/type information. Results include provider_state, project_anchor, project_anchor_source, warmup_performed, and semantic_result_inconclusive metadata so empty semantic results and heuristic warm-up anchors are not over-interpreted. project_anchor_source=warmup_candidate means the anchor is only a project-activation hint, not proof that the symbol was found there. Prefer this for code symbols; use search_files for raw text and read_files for implementation details after locating the symbol.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Navigate definitions, references, symbols, implementations, and hover information through active language services.

path.description: Workspace source path. Workspace-relative is preferred; absolute paths are accepted only when they remain inside the workspace. For workspace_symbols this is optional and may be a project/file/directory anchor.

languageModelTools.name: shuncode_wait
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Block for a fixed amount of time, then return. Use to let a background command (run_command with background=true) make progress before reading its output with get_command_output, or to give a server/watcher time to emit more output. Choose one wait long enough for the expected work (e.g. 10-30 seconds for builds, up to 120 seconds for slow compiles) instead of polling get_command_output in a tight loop. The wait only sleeps; it does not check command status.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Wait a fixed amount of time.

shuncode.model.baseUrl.description: OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible base URL used by ShunCode.

shuncode.model.name.description: Model identifier exposed in the native Chat model picker and used by the ShunCode Agent Runtime.

shuncode.chat.bridgeStyleUI.description: Render ShunCode Chat tool activity with the compact Bridge-inspired card style. This setting does not change Bridge mode.

shuncode.runtime.entryPoint.description: Optional absolute path to dist/src/agent-host.js. The ShunCode carrier normally injects this automatically.

shuncode.bridge.ngrokDomain.description: Reserved ngrok HTTPS hostname used by the ShunCode Streamable HTTP MCP Bridge, for example your-name.ngrok-free.dev.

shuncode.bridge.ngrokUseHttpProxy.description: Let the ngrok tunnel process use the resolved VS Code/system HTTP proxy. Requires an ngrok Pay-as-you-go plan; ngrok Free rejects HTTP proxies with ERR_NGROK_9009. Keep this off to run ngrok in direct connection mode.

shuncode.bridge.cloudflareNamedDomain.description: Fixed HTTPS hostname configured as a Cloudflare Tunnel published application, for example mcp.example.com.

shuncode.bridge.cloudflareNamedLocalPort.description: Fixed localhost port used by Cloudflare Named Tunnel. Configure the Cloudflare published application Service URL as http://127.0.0.1:<port>.

enumDescriptions: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel. No account or domain required; the public URL changes after restart.
Cloudflare Named Tunnel. Stable hostname; requires a Cloudflare account, managed domain, Tunnel Token, and published application route.
ngrok reserved domain. Requires an ngrok account, Authtoken, and configured domain.
shuncode.bridge.tunnelProvider.description: Public tunnel provider used by ShunCode Bridge.

shuncode.bridge.persistentMode.description: Open ShunCode in Bridge mode and start the Bridge automatically after the Chat view has finished rendering.

shuncode.bridge.startupTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for the public Bridge health endpoint after the tunnel reports readiness. Deterministic network failures (DNS or connection refused) abort startup earlier regardless of this limit.

shuncode.bridge.quickLinks.description: Custom quick-open shortcuts shown as buttons at the top of the Bridge page. Each opens in the ShunCode built-in browser.

shuncode.multiModel.enabled.description: Enable multi-model rounds. In Plan mode, different models answer the same question from the context before the previous round; the merge model reads all branches and, when necessary, performs read-only file verification, producing consensus, disagreements, and the final plan. Only adopted branches continue into subsequent context. When disabled, an empty input no longer triggers branch sending.

shuncode.multiModel.mergeModel.description: Merge model in vendor/modelId format. Leave empty to use the model selected in the current conversation when merging.

shuncode.multiModel.mergeReadTools.description: Allow the merge model to perform read-only file verification when merging. Files are read only when branches disagree or the conclusion lacks evidence.

shuncode.multiModel.maxBranches.description: Maximum number of branches per round. When the limit is reached, merge or adopt a branch before generating more branches for the same question.

shuncode.multiModel.mergeReasoningEffort.description: Thinking effort used by the merge model when summarizing branches. Only applies when shuncode.multiModel.mergeModel is set to a separate merge model; otherwise merging follows the thinking setting of the current conversation. If the merge model does not support the selected effort (DeepSeek supports low/high/max only; Codex models cannot disable thinking), the merge model default effort is used instead.
